title: cyclobothra flava
intro: Cyclobothra flava, commonly known as the yellow cyclocarya, is a plant species found in China and other parts of Asia. It is known for its potential health benefits, particularly in lowering cholesterol levels and improving cardiovascular health due to its anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of Cyclobothra flava are attributed to its ability to inhibit the production of triglycerides and LDL cholesterol, thereby reducing the risk of heart disease. The plant's bioactive constituents include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its therapeutic effects.
